sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.317 of 2023, under Section 376, 323, 504 IPC,
P.S. Loni Katra, District Barabanki.
3.

In terms of the FIR registered on 28.10.2023, it was alleged that the applicant who is also brother-in-law of the victim had called her to his home and for a period of six months allegedly,
formed physical relations with her.
It was also stated that she became pregnant.
It was also stated that subsequently she was got married to the relative of the applicant.

It was also stated that now Ramesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89845439/
1 she was being forced to stay with the applicant and not with her husband.

entities.text: Ramesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., a similar allegation was levelled.

In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.,
there were slight contradictions, although, it was admitted that she was married to the relative of the applicant and was carrying a fetus of four months.
The victim refused to undergo medical examination.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the inordinate delay in lodging the FIR coupled with the fact that the statements are not corroborated by any medical on record and the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 02.11.2023, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

In view thereof,
the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Ramesh Kumar be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
